title: Fravor and Dietrich saw appendages on Underwood's FLIR tape
place_text: USS Nimitz area, off Southern California

tellings.quote: both commander uh Fraver and uh Lieutenant Commander Dietrich have stated that when they reviewed Underwood's tapes afterwards, they saw these little appendages, these protrusions.

plain: When two Navy pilots, Commander David Fravor and Lieutenant Commander Alex Dietrich, later watched the infrared camera tape fellow pilot Chad Underwood shot in 2004 near the carrier USS Nimitz, they saw little appendages sticking out of the object, which was a white oval shaped like a Tic Tac mint. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff says both pilots have stated this, raising it with Michels in a debate with the skeptic Mick West. It would mean the object had features the blurry footage alone does not show.
